lines: A web page becomes 121 tokens instead of 15,704.
Agents waste huge chunks of your budget reading massive files.
Caveman makes your AI agent say less and read less by talking like a caveman.
It compresses logs, CSVs, and code files to under one percent of their original size while keeping every number exact.
Logs shrink to 348 tokens from an original 22,810.
The session run is from August 2026 on an engine that only got the JSON file down to 8,106 tokens.
Adobe Research found cost cut 1.4 to 2.4 times per model.
Memory files like CLAUDE.md get 46% smaller with every heading and code block intact.
It runs on Go and works in Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude Code.
Julius Brussee made it with Apache-2.0 license and Adobe Research tested it.
Run this command in your terminal: npx skills add JuliusBrussee/caveman minus g.
Send this to someone who wants fewer tokens with exact numbers.
Talk like a caveman to save tokens.
